title: Result panel can render below the fold on short phones after Calculate
evidence: Verified by the task 3 reviewer in Chrome mobile emulation: at 360x640 and 390x664 the Calculate button bottom is y=627 and the result panel starts at y=668, outside the viewport; nothing scrolls it into view. At 360x740 and 412x800 it is fully visible. Screen reader users get the result through the role=status live region.
impact: Sighted touch users on short screens see no outcome until they scroll.
precautions: A fix such as scrollIntoView({ block: 'nearest' }) on status change needs a jsdom stub in src/test/setup.ts and must respect prefers-reduced-motion; do not move focus to the result.
